title: Pirate Ships Were Pure Democracies
hook: Pirate crews elected their captains and voted on destinations.

scenes.text: While European monarchs ruled with iron fists, 18th-century pirate ships practiced radical pure democracy.
scenes.imagePrompt: Sunlit quarterdeck of a wooden pirate galleon with ship's wheel, compass binnacle, and voting ballot box on a barrel. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: While European monarchs ruled with iron fists, 18th-century pirate ships practiced radical pure democracy.

scenes.text: Every crewman had an equal vote when electing their captain, choosing which merchant trade routes to raid, and deciding when to retreat.
scenes.imagePrompt: Nautical navigation chart laid across a wooden capstan with brass dividers, calipers, and a horn rum cup. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Every crewman had an equal vote when electing their captain, choosing which merchant trade routes to raid, and deciding when to retreat.

scenes.text: If a captain proved cowardly, greedy, or abusive, the crew held a vote and instantly demoted him back to regular deckhand.
scenes.imagePrompt: Stern captain's quarters with leaded glass windows overlooking ocean wake and an empty high-backed oak chair. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: If a captain proved cowardly, greedy, or abusive, the crew held a vote and instantly demoted him back to regular deckhand.

scenes.text: Poot loot was divided with strict equality: captains received only two shares, while standard crew members received one full share.

scenes.voicedText: Poot loot was divided with strict equality: captains received only two shares, while standard crew members received one full share.

scenes.text: They even had the world's first worker disability insurance: losing an eye paid one hundred pieces of eight, and losing a leg paid six hundred.
